name: ghostscript
description: PostScript and PDF interpreter, renderer, and converter with advanced imaging capabilities

gs.description: PostScript and PDF interpreter with comprehensive rendering, conversion, and manipulation capabilities
gs.usage:
gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -sOutputFile=output.pdf input.ps # Convert PostScript to PDF
gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dPDFSETTINGS=/ebook -sOutputFile=compressed.pdf input.pdf # Compress PDF
gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=png16m -r300 -sOutputFile=page_%03d.png input.pdf # Convert PDF to PNG images
gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=jpeg -r150 -sOutputFile=output.jpg input.pdf # Convert to JPEG
gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=txtwrite -sOutputFile=output.txt input.pdf # Extract text from PDF
gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dColorConversionStrategy=/Gray -sOutputFile=gray.pdf input.pdf # Convert to grayscale
gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dFirstPage=1 -dLastPage=5 -sOutputFile=pages1-5.pdf input.pdf # Extract specific pages
gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=eps2write -sOutputFile=output.eps input.pdf # Convert PDF to EPS
gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dDetectDuplicateImages=true -sOutputFile=optimized.pdf input.pdf # Optimize PDF size
